classifications.label: Measured portal placement and related menu sizing
classifications.note: Positions derive from live trigger/popover boxes. Keep coordinate owner and scroll/resize behavior; mixed objects contain static position/fixed-width portions that can move to classes separately. CSS custom properties may represent measured values after focused interaction verification.

classifications.label: Measured layout, progress, and drag-state transitions
classifications.note: Values come from resize/measurement hooks, viewport bounds, nesting depth, usage/progress data, or drag state. Transition selections may become conditional classes, but preserve measured dimensions and animation timing; do not substitute a fixed utility for runtime values.

classifications.label: SyntaxHighlighter theme interface
classifications.note: The style prop is the renderer library theme-map API, not a DOM CSSProperties bag. Replacing it with a CSS-variable-only object breaks its contract. Review renderer configuration or a narrow rule contract separately.

classifications.label: Dropdown accessibility and embedding contract
classifications.note: Nine visually-hidden CSS properties are reported twice because the shared object styles two hidden controls (18 diagnostics, 9 source properties). The source explicitly retains inline styles to survive host CSS pipelines. A class migration requires bundled/scoped embedded CSS and accessibility verification.

classifications.label: External MCP catalog brand colors
classifications.note: iconBg/iconColor come from the integration catalog, with a white brand fallback. They are provider-owned brand values. Decide the brand rendering contract before adding theme tokens or a targeted exception; avoid broad allowlists.

classifications.label: Existing semantic context-window track expression
classifications.note: The track uses color-mix of --oh-context-window-foreground and --oh-context-window-track-weight, with contrast tests across shipped themes. This is already token-owned color. Moving the expression to a static class/theme role can remove the DOM style while preserving its values; avoid approximating with a surface token.

classifications.label: Runtime animation and caller-style composition
classifications.note: Onboarding transform depends on slide offset. TextShimmer composes caller style, duration/spread and generated keyframe names; one diagnostic is its style element. Consider dedicated CSS/custom-property design with reduced-motion and caller-style coverage, not blanket replacement.

classifications.label: Fixed numeric constants suitable for isolated migration
classifications.note: Each is a named constant shared with a geometry or cap owner: overview-column width, diff-editor cap, or sparkline track height. A local class backed by a numeric custom property can preserve the single constant owner without hardcoding a second value. Verify scoped rendering and dependent geometry.

classifications.label: Sidebar transition duration coupled to lifecycle timing
classifications.note: Both mobile drawer surfaces derive CSS transition duration from MOBILE_DRAWER_TRANSITION_MS, also used for unmount timing. Preserve that shared owner when migrating to a duration utility/custom property and verify the visible temporal transition.
